Recorded claim:
Provisional D325810 fit: use `tb-banner variant="warning"` with the failed-save sentence as title and status/server detail in the expandable description; choose `moz-message-bar` if all detail must remain visible or narrow-width wrapping outweighs disclosure. Test long names, narrow panes, zoom, and larger text because `tb-banner` keeps “Show more” non-wrapping on the icon/title/action row. [Task 1]
